headline: onsemi seeks leadership for analog design agents, architecture exploration and agent qualification
fact: onsemi advertised Senior Director, AI NPD Platforms & Engineering Intelligence role 2506790 to define and govern agentic-AI semiconductor development. Duties include analog and verification agents, AI-enabled circuit design and architecture exploration, and an approved agent library with qualification, validation, versioning, release and human-review processes. The role spans additional disciplines, but circuit/architecture and verification work provide the qualifying scope. It is a development and governance hiring mandate, not evidence that the proposed platform or productivity gains have been delivered.
